title: トランプ氏、欧州のイラン対応に不満募らせ　駐独米軍の削減決定
extracted_text: 米国防総省は1日、ドイツに駐留する米軍約5000人を削減すると発表した。今後、半年から1年かけて撤収させるという。トランプ米大統領はかねて対イラン軍事作戦をめぐる欧州の関与が不十分との不満を募らせ、先月下旬にはイラン情勢を巡って対米批判を展開したメルツ独首相に怒りの矛先を向けていた。今回の削減決定で、米国の欧州への関与がさらに低下する可能性がある。 米国防総省によると、ドイツには欧州最大規模の約3万6400人の米軍が駐留している。米メディアによると、バイデン前政権が2026年中に始めるとしていた長距離火力大隊の配備も取りやめる。
translated_text: The US Department of Defense announced on May 1 that it will reduce approximately 5,000 US troops stationed in Germany, with withdrawal expected to take six months to a year. President Trump has long been frustrated by what he sees as Europe's inadequate involvement in military operations against Iran. Late last month, he directed his criticism at German Chancellor Merkel, who had voiced US-focused concerns regarding the Iran situation. This decision to reduce troops could further diminish US involvement in Europe. According to the Pentagon, approximately 36,400 US troops are stationed in Germany—the largest US military presence in Europe. US media also reported that the previous Biden administration had planned to deploy long-range firepower units starting in 2026, but that deployment has been canceled as well.
title_en: Trump Frustrated with Europe's Iran Response, Decides to Cut US Troops in Germany
